title: 环境与公共措施词汇
goal: 能选用环境与公共措施词汇并判断措施的相关性。

points.label: 选用环境与公共措施的准确词汇
判断措施表述与问题是否相关

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 环境与公共措施词汇的内容和教学规格

body.p: 环境类议论先写污染来源，再写公共措施如何改变排放或资源使用。用词要对应具体的来源、行动和预期效果。

body.box: Frequent buses may reduce the number of car journeys on a busy route.

body.p: 例句把增加公交班次和减少汽车出行联系起来。效果要看乘客是否改乘公交。

body.box: A town centre has heavy traffic at the busiest times of day. Car exhaust contributes to local air pollution, while congestion makes bus journeys less reliable. The council could reserve a lane for buses and increase service frequency. If these changes make buses a practical alternative, some commuters may leave their cars at home. Fewer car journeys could reduce traffic emissions, although the result would depend on how many people change their travel habits.

body.p: 问题是交通拥堵和汽车排放。专用道和增加班次改善了公交服务，汽车出行可能因此减少。效果要看通勤者是否改变出行方式。

groups.fill: Frequent bus services can improve local transport. A time{table} shows rou{tes} and fa{res} for passe{ngers}. Reliable serv{ices} reduce del{ays} on jour{neys} to workp{laces}. Improved acc{ess} supports comm{uters}. The council can publish this information at stops and provide more buses when demand is high. The effect of these measures depends on whether residents find the routes and times suitable for their journeys. A service must also remain affordable if passengers are to use it regularly.
notes: timetable：显示班次信息的时刻表。

groups.text: A neighbourhood produces more household waste than its existing collection system can handle. Bins are often full before collection day, and some waste is left beside them. The council proposes more frequent collection and separate containers for recyclable materials. Collection would remove accumulated waste sooner, while sorting could help recover suitable materials. The council would need to explain which items belong in each container. Clear instructions could be delivered to each household and displayed on the containers. Collection staff could also report locations where the new capacity remains insufficient. The council could then adjust the service in those areas rather than assuming that one schedule suits every street. Separate containers are useful only if the materials collected can be handled by an appropriate recycling facility. These actions address the handling of waste after households have produced it; they do not by themselves reduce the amount purchased by households. A separate policy would be needed to address purchasing choices.

items.stem: What does collection refer to in the proposal?
options: Removing waste from households and bins.
Sorting recyclable items into containers.
Reporting areas where bins are too full.
Delivering instructions to households.
items.why: collection 指把垃圾从垃圾箱或住户处收走。

items.stem: Which action addresses bins becoming full before collection?
options: Deliver instructions on which items go in each bin.
Arrange for waste to be collected more frequently.
Display sorting rules on the recycling containers.
Send recyclable materials to a recycling facility.
items.why: 材料说 Collection would remove accumulated waste sooner。第二项更频繁地清运，直接针对垃圾箱在清运日前已满的问题。

items.stem: What is the purpose of sorting in this proposal?
options: Remove accumulated waste from the streets more quickly.
Reduce the amount of goods that households purchase.
Separate suitable materials so they can be recovered.
Show staff where the new capacity is insufficient.
items.why: sorting could help recover suitable materials 说明分类的用途。

items.stem: Which explanation links separate containers to the stated objective?
options: They ensure households buy fewer goods immediately.
They prevent all waste from being produced at home.
They replace the need to explain collection rules.
They keep recyclable materials apart for recovery.
items.why: 分类容器使可回收材料分开，便于回收利用。

items.stem: Which additional issue is not directly solved by the proposed measures?
options: The number of goods bought by households.
The frequency of emptying bins.
The separation of suitable recyclable materials.
The removal of accumulated household waste.
items.why: 材料指出清运和分类本身不会减少住户购买量。

groups.fill: A town is changing the way it handles household materials. The wa{ste} needs colle{ction} in conta{iners} for recy{cling}. Better sor{ting} makes re{use} of reso{urces} more effi{cient}. This ser{vice} limits poll{ution}. The council plans to explain which materials can be collected and where the containers will be placed. Residents will need clear instructions if they are to separate items correctly. The plan also requires a facility that can process the materials after collection and return suitable resources to use.

groups.text: A city wants to reduce emissions from journeys into its centre. Many commuters currently drive because buses on the main route are delayed by traffic and do not run frequently. The council proposes a dedicated bus lane and additional services. A bus lane would allow buses to pass some queues, while extra services could reduce waiting times. Together, these changes may make public transport a more practical option for commuters. If some drivers switch to buses, the number of car journeys could fall, reducing emissions from those journeys. The council also plans to publish a clear timetable so that passengers can plan their trips. These measures cannot guarantee that every commuter will change travel habits. People whose journeys are not served by the route may still need another option. The proposal therefore links a specific source of emissions to changes in transport provision, while recognising that its effect depends on how residents respond.

items.stem: What does emissions refer to in the passage?
options: Substances released by vehicles during journeys.
The times printed on a bus service timetable.
The routes taken by passengers between buses.
The number of car journeys into the centre.
items.why: emissions from journeys 指车辆出行产生的排放物。

items.stem: Which measure is intended to reduce delays caused by traffic queues?
options: Publish a timetable showing existing delays.
Reserve a lane for buses on the main route.
Remove extra services from the main route.
Add a route for journeys outside the centre.
items.why: bus lane would allow buses to pass some queues 说明专用道的作用。

options: The amount of exhaust released by each vehicle.
The number of passengers who own a private car.
How often buses run on the proposed route.
How many streets have a published timetable.
items.why: run frequently 指公交班次出现的频率。

items.stem: Why could additional bus services help address the stated problem?
options: They guarantee every commuter stops driving immediately.
They make the bus lane unnecessary for passing queues.
They increase waiting times for people using buses.
They may reduce waits and make buses more practical.
items.why: extra services could reduce waiting times，可能使公交更实用。

items.stem: What condition links the transport measures to lower car emissions?
options: Some drivers choose buses instead of cars.
The council publishes a clear timetable.
Every commuter's journey is served by the route.
Passengers can plan their trips in advance.
items.why: If some drivers switch to buses 指出减少汽车出行的条件。
